purpose: Development rule defining the only two routes by which forge internals reach documents (direct reference for built-in docs, wrapper queries for project specs/rules) and restricting document-search backend references to wrappers.
summary: Two access routes only: A direct path reference and B query via wrapper skills
Route A scope: built-in plugin docs or a skill's own docs directory; never another skill's docs
Route B: project specs/rules accessed through query-db-specs and query-db-rules
Rationale: built-in docs update with releases so fixed paths stay valid; project docs change often
Anti-patterns: querying built-in docs, referencing project docs from distributions, procedures as docs, session_dir file passing, cross-skill docs
Backend name may appear only in wrapper skills and the doc_backend scripts
Exemptions for mechanically written index identifiers and the single place per layer that explains the backend
External use note: query-forge-rules is the entry point for outside users
tasks: Writing or editing SKILL.md files that read documents

Reviewing changes for document reference violations

Promoting shared documents to plugin-level docs
